Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary filtering on target CHEMBL1293293. Join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Filter for standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Return first 1000 rows.
